description: Compare a HELOC against a second mortgage for tapping home equity in Canada. Returns how much you can borrow (revolving HELOC capped at 65% LTV, total secured borrowing to 80% with an A lender), monthly payments, TDS qualification at the OSFI stress-test rate, and the equivalent numbers for B and private lenders.

amountToBorrow.description: Amount you want to borrow in CAD

annualHouseholdIncome.description: Gross annual household income in CAD

existingMonthlyDebts.description: Other monthly debt payments (car, cards, loans)

extraMonthlyPrincipal.description: Optional extra principal paid monthly on the HELOC

helocPrimeRatePct.description: Prime rate as a percent; defaults to the site's current prime

helocSpreadPct.description: Lender spread over prime as a percent, e.g. 0.5

homeValue.description: Current market value of the home in CAD

outstandingFirstMortgage.description: Balance remaining on the first mortgage in CAD

secondMortgageLenderTier.description: A = bank/credit union, B = trust/MIC, Private = individual investor

secondMortgageRatePct.description: Second mortgage rate as a percent; defaults to the tier's typical rate

name: heloc_second_mortgage
title: HELOC & Second Mortgage Calculator (Canada)
